extraction.agency_name: Board of Trustees of the Maryland Teachers and State Employees Supplemental Retirement Plans

findings.title: Unrealized Losses of ICP Principal Were Not Adequately Disclosed to Existing and Prospective Participants
findings.description: MSRP did not adequately disclose unrealized losses of ICP principal totaling approximately $48 million as of December 2008 in financial reports made available to plan participants. This inadequate disclosure limited the ability of participants to make informed investment decisions.
findings.recommendation: MSRP should specifically disclose the actual dollar amount of ICP unrealized losses or gains to existing and prospective plan participants on an ongoing basis, and provide a plain language description of the wrapper exposure.

findings.title: Unrealized Losses of Investment Principal Were Not Disclosed in MSRP’s Audited Financial Statements
findings.description: MSRP did not disclose ICP's unrealized losses totaling approximately $5 million as of December 31, 2007, in its audited financial statements. The applicable accounting principles require disclosure of both the investments' cost and fair value.
findings.recommendation: MSRP should disclose the fair value of the ICP investments in its annual audited financial statements and ensure that the existence of ICP investments is periodically confirmed with the custodian bank.

findings.title: Documentation of Independent Market Valuations of ICP Investments Was Lacking
findings.description: MSRP lacked documentation to substantiate that the market value of ICP investments reported by sub-managers had been independently verified. There was no documentation on file to support that the market values reported to the Board were independently verified.
findings.recommendation: MSRP should obtain, on a periodic basis (at least quarterly), independent verifications of the market values of investments held by the ICP.

findings.title: The Accuracy of the Interest Rate Used to Credit Earnings to Participant Accounts Was Not Independently Verified by MSRP
findings.description: MSRP did not independently verify the accuracy of the interest rates calculated by the investment manager and used to credit participant accounts. The investment manager issued a written disclaimer as to the accuracy of its calculations.
findings.recommendation: MSRP should work with the investment manager to eliminate disclaimers relating to the accuracy and validity of the crediting rate calculation and establish a process to verify the accuracy of the crediting rate.

findings.title: Wrapper (Insurance) Agreements Executed to Cover Investment Losses Appear Highly Complex and Ambiguous
findings.description: Wrapper agreements were highly complex and ambiguous, and MSRP was unable to clearly explain how they preserve the investment portfolio. Certain agreements were not signed until after documents were requested.

dollar_amounts.context: payments made to wrapper providers during fiscal year 2008

findings.recommendation: MSRP should obtain clarification about how the agreements protect the ICP investment portfolio, maintain current signed wrapper agreements, and monitor the financial status of wrapper providers.

findings.title: Monitoring of Sub-Managers Performance Was Not Adequately Documented
findings.description: MSRP management and the Board did not adequately document efforts to monitor the performance of sub-managers. There was no substantive documentation of efforts taken to address sub-manager performance issues.
findings.recommendation: MSRP should establish procedures to adequately document the monitoring of the performance of the sub-managers and ensure that sub-managers submit all required monthly reports.

findings.title: Oversight of the Investment Manager Was Not Adequately Documented
findings.description: MSRP management and the Board were not adequately documenting their monitoring of the performance of the investment manager. Issues noted included use of incorrect benchmarks for evaluation.
findings.recommendation: MSRP should establish procedures to adequately document its monitoring of the investment manager’s performance and assess the adequacy of benchmarks used.

findings.title: Certain Conditions Recommended by MSRP’s Legal Counsel Were Not Compiled With
findings.description: Conditions recommended by legal counsel for approval of a waiver were not complied with. There was no documentation that the Board had addressed conditions regarding affirmation and maximum size of investments.
findings.recommendation: MSRP should take immediate action to ensure that all conditions that were previously established by its legal counsel for approval of the waiver are complied with.

findings.title: Documentation Was Lacking That a Financial Relationship Between the Investment Manager and a Sub-Manager Had Been Disclosed to the MSRP Board
findings.description: Documentation was not maintained to substantiate that a financial relationship between the investment manager and a sub-manager was disclosed to, and approved by, the MSRP Board.
findings.recommendation: MSRP should present this matter to the Board for evaluation, seek guidance from the State Ethics Commission, and take appropriate action.

findings.title: An Alternative Conservative Investment Option Was Not Offered to Certain Plan Participants
findings.description: The Board and MSRP did not offer other conservative investment options (such as a money market fund) to participants in the 401(a), 401(k), and 457 Plans.
findings.recommendation: The Board and MSRP should consider offering an alternative conservative investment option (such as a money market fund) to 401(a), 401(k), and 457 Plan participants.

extraction.agency_response_summary: MSRP agreed with the factual accuracy of findings 1-3 but disagreed with recommendation 1 regarding dollar amount disclosure. They implemented recommendations for findings 2 and 3 (disclosure in statements, independent verification). Responses for findings 4-10 were not included in the provided text.
